text: unsay these words that be freighted with death for thee, and ruin for all that be near to thee. Shake of this gruesome dream. Call back thy poor wandering memory. Look upon me. Am not I thy mother that bore thee, and loveth thee?” The Prince shook his head and reluctantly said-- “God knoweth I am loth to grieve thy heart; but truly have I never looked upon thy face before.” The woman sank back to a sitting posture on the floor, and, covering her eyes with her hands, gave way to heart-broken sobs and wailings.
